description: Independently checks whether a receipt is cryptographically VALID, INVALID, or UNVERIFIABLE, with a reason code. Free, no payment. Pass EITHER receipt_id (looks it up first, must be public) OR a complete receipt envelope you already hold (verified directly, no publication needed). This is a convenient ONLINE check -- it trusts this server to have honestly fetched the real signing-key registry. Running the same check yourself offline (the published @onchaindiligence/agent-evidence package) is a strictly stronger trust position; this tool does not replace that option.

envelope.description: A complete receipt envelope you already hold ({schema, receipt, proof}) to verify directly. Mutually exclusive with receipt_id.

receipt_id.description: Look up and verify a public receipt by exact id. Mutually exclusive with envelope.

name: verify_receipt
